notes: 'the humblest parasite which clings to the hairs of a quadruped or feathers of a bird' and 'the parasite which clings to the hair on the tiger's body': lice are the best fit, but ticks or fleas are possible. GBIF places lice within Psocodea and has no Phthiraptera node.
